technique_name: Compare and contrast the four types of memory: sensory, short-term, working, and long-term.
description: Sensory memory is a very brief memory that lasts for just a few seconds after an experience or event is experienced. It is important for noticing details from the environment and briefly storing the information for a brief period of time. Short-term memory is a type of memory used for temporarily storing and recalling information.
